description: This file declares functions and interfaces for Android network operations within the Chromium project, including certificate verification, network status checks, WiFi info, DNS configuration, and socket management.

methods.name: GetUserAddedRoots
methods.description: Retrieves a list of user-added root certificates from Android in DER format.

methods.name: VerifyX509CertChain
methods.description: Verifies a chain of DER-encoded certificates against Android trust store, checking server trustworthiness.

methods.name: AddTestRootCertificate
methods.description: Adds a DER-encoded certificate as a trusted root for testing purposes.

methods.name: ClearTestRootCertificates
methods.description: Removes all test root certificates added via AddTestRootCertificate.

methods.name: IsCleartextPermitted
methods.description: Checks if cleartext network traffic is permitted for a given host.

methods.name: HaveOnlyLoopbackAddresses
methods.description: Determines if only loopback addresses are configured on the device.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Returns the MIME type associated with a file extension.

methods.name: GetTelephonyNetworkOperator
methods.description: Returns the mobile network operator's MCC+MNC code.

methods.name: GetIsRoaming
methods.description: Checks if the device is currently roaming.

methods.name: GetIsCaptivePortal
methods.description: Determines if the captive portal probe was blocked.

methods.name: GetWifiSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the connected WiFi access point.

methods.name: SetWifiEnabledForTesting
methods.description: Enables or disables WiFi for testing.

methods.name: GetWifiSignalLevel
methods.description: Gets the signal strength level of the WiFi connection.

methods.name: GetCurrentDnsServers
methods.description: Retrieves DNS servers and private DNS settings for the current network.

methods.name: GetDnsServersForNetwork
methods.description: Retrieves DNS servers and settings for a specific network.

methods.name: ReportBadDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Reports connectivity issues with the default network to the OS.

methods.name: TagSocket
methods.description: Applies traffic stats tags and UID to a socket.

methods.name: BindToNetwork
methods.description: Binds socket traffic to a specific network.

methods.name: GetAddrInfoForNetwork
methods.description: Performs hostname resolution via network-specific DNS servers.
